module.purpose: Provides the booking flow with a fully-loaded, validated EventType record from the database, including hosts, users, workflows, availability, credentials, and parsed metadata, as an input prerequisite for handleNewBooking.
module.summary: This module fetches an event type by ID for the new-booking flow. It defines a large Prisma select object (getEventTypesFromDBSelect) covering scheduling settings, booking limits, seats, recurring events, locations, workflows, hosts with credentials and schedules, availability, and team/organization relations. The exported async function getEventTypesFromDB queries Prisma's eventType with findUniqueOrThrow, throws ErrorCode.EventTypeNotFound if missing, then transforms the result: annotates hosts and users with their selected calendars, parses metadata, recurringEvent, customInputs, and rrSegmentQueryValue with Zod schemas, normalizes locations, and derives booking fields (with system fields) alongside an isOrgTeamEvent flag. It returns a normalized object marked isDynamic: false. Exported types getEventTypeResponse and NewBookingEventType are consumed by the booking handler to unify dynamic-listing and database-backed event types.
module.businessContext: Core of Cal.com's scheduling engine: every new booking needs the event type's configuration (hosts, limits, workflows, availability). If this fails or returns malformed data, bookings cannot be created and scheduling rules may be bypassed.
